title: Metal command runtime operational wait policy

timeoutNs.description: Default elapsed-time budget shared by all submitted commands in one operational retirement call. Explicit queue-port timeout inputs override the instance default. Timeout retains unfinished work. Destruction drains terminal completion separately and may block.

pollIntervalNs.description: Polling-mode sleep between native status observations, capped to the remaining wait budget. Scheduling can delay wakeup; this is not a hard real-time deadline.
